cues.text: A 50-year-old man has recent onset of pain in his face.
The pain lies over his upper and lower jaws.
Simple things set it off. Washing his face brings on the pain.
When he shaves, the same pain in his face comes back.
Even eating a meal can bring the pain on as well.
Even a cold wind blowing on his face can trigger it.
So which nerve carries feeling from his face and both jaws?
This is trigeminal neuralgia, pain in the sensory distribution of the trigeminal nerve.
So the nerve causing his symptoms is the trigeminal nerve.
